title: STAR project walkthrough
summary: A synthetic interview page for testing question blocks and long-form reading.

rows: What changed and how was it measured?

blocks.question: How do you keep the answer technical without becoming too long?
blocks.answer: Name the architecture and your decisions, then spend detail only on the difficult trade-off or failure you solved.
blocks.followUp: Can you explain the same example in 60 seconds and 3 minutes?

items: Separate team work from your contribution.
Give a measurable result where available.
